text_to_image_prompt:
Create ONE landscape 3:2 full-body turnaround sheet: exactly THREE equal-size head-to-toe figures of the SAME character and costume, left strict FRONT, center strict 90-degree SIDE facing right, right strict BACK. All at same scale, height and foot baseline, all hair and footwear visible, arms naturally down. No extra portraits or panels. Character-specific body: 192 cm excluding fox ears, regal broad-shouldered athletic torso. Approximately 8.0 to 8.2 anatomical heads tall from skull crown (exclude tall hair, crown, ears and hat) to soles. Long elegant legs and arms, natural normal neck, proportionate head; do not fake height with heels, tiny shrunken head, stretched neck or camera distortion. Different characters retain distinctive builds. Full outfit: Same antique gold upper chest armor, burgundy silk drape continuing as long layered ceremonial robe panels around legs, dark plum trousers, engraved gold shin guards and dark gold-trimmed boots. Preserve fox ears and ponytail, no extra tails invented.
Premium semi-realistic dimensional 3D character CG: finely sculpted face, delicate luminous skin microtexture, soft subsurface scattering, crisp eyes, individual wispy hair strands, detailed fabric and metal. Pure opaque white seamless studio background, bright soft neutral frontal light with balanced fill, subtle contact shadow. No text, labels, watermark, frame or collage borders. Preserve original age, facial anatomy, ethnicity, hair, eyes and accessories.
Character design: Adult MALE fox spirit age 28, regal athletic humanoid. Long dark plum hair tied high, two sweeping deep-purple fox ears with gold-tipped fur, fully inside frame. Burnished ruby eyes, wide strong cheekbones, long nose with softly broad tip, sharp brows, full well-shaped lips, square tapered jaw. Warm porcelain skin. Original fine gold forehead ornament with a single oval garnet, new sparse abstract crimson markings at temples and shoulders. Sculpted antique-gold upper chest armor with burgundy silk drape and layered fine gold collar; tasteful non-explicit fantasy costume. Proud composed frontal gaze. Ears and ponytail wholly visible.
